AC4 (amended) — «Объекты» POST on a no-object company → office + journals by objects + audit (stand); onboarding template on a no-object company → «Основная точка» + office, all 7 rooms/areas and 6 equipment on the object (stand); questionnaire ensureLocationBuildings(3) → 3 objects + office, second call creates nothing; demo checked statically; directory exchange no longer opens the office (guard + E2E). Consequence: a company whose first objects arrive through the exchange keeps «objects, no office» until its office page is visited or it creates its own object.

AC5 — stand: dry-run «3 / 2 / 2» = real «3 / 2 / 2» + 1 manager session; repeat prints «already done» for both runs; directory cabinet and no-object company untouched; taken names → «Офис организации» at min sortOrder − 1; audit building.office_opened {source, created, perLocationJournalsBefore}; manager bound to the object bumped, cook without a place not. deploy.yml: after post-deploy-check.sh, outside the PRISMA_HASH/legacy blocks, dry-run first, both runs `|| echo [warn]`, only totals printed (no query logs in production).
openOfficesForAllOrganizations has no per-company try/catch: one failing company ends the run (exit 1 → [warn]); the once-key is not written, so the next deploy retries, but companies after it wait.

openOrganizationOffice — 4 parallel calls on one company: 1 office, 1 audit entry. The actor is excluded from closePointManagerSessions and, unlike the removed button, not moved to the office: an office-page visitor bound to objects keeps a company-wide pointScope in the JWT until the next session refresh (pages recompute it per request; the proxy reads the token).

Deploy-step consequence accepted by the spec but worth telling the owner: a manager — owner included — bound to all objects (or to the only object) becomes a point manager after re-login and loses company-only pages (/settings/organization, creating objects); the removed button protected its creator by moving them to the office.

AC8 — stand: a general current-period «hygiene» document survives the office opening; auto-creation for the object returns already-active (same document), broken-chain restore returns has-current-document, one document in total, visible on the object via buildingWhere. Toggle hidden while the office exists (canSplitJournals); PATCH perLocationJournals=false → 400.

AC10 — waiter without a place lands on the first object (mini «Сегодня»: «WeSetup · Цех пищевых продуктов»), unit tests cover cookie/office-staff/«вся организация».
